dedupe_keys.name: super grid transformer power flow historic

description: Super Grid Transformer Power Flow Historic is a dataset listed in UK Power Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by UK Power Networks. Introduction Daily Demand Statistics (Minimum, Average, Maximum) for Grid Supply Point (GSP). It includes aggregated GSP Data for all the monitored GSPs, and it also includes SGT data if we have used those for the creation of aggregated data. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Network Usage. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ukpn-open-data-portal.
